key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to efficiently optimize expensive, high-dimensional process simulations.
engineering_relevance: It can reduce costly high-fidelity simulator calls in industrial flowsheet design while preserving strong optimization performance.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to keep only the most influential design variables.
Fit a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process that links cheap approximations with expensive simulations.
Drive sampling with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion logic across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—a plasmid DNA bioprocess in SuperPro Designer and a green fuel plant in Aspen HYSYS—and it reduced high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the reduced space and fidelity correlation, so weak sensitivity rankings or poorly matched low-fidelity models could limit gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
